name: Serve Two Masters
body:
You now have two patrons.

Prerequisite: CL 11, Extra Familiar, witch’s familiar class feature.

Benefit: You gain a second patron and an additional set of patron spells. The new set of spells is learned by the familiar gained with the Extra Familiar feat.
